title: China AI supplier Zhongji Innolight slips in Hong Kong debut after $6.8 billion IPO
summary_full: Shares of Zhongji Innolight fell on Thursday after the Chinese optical transceiver maker made its trading debut on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
